originality.rationale: The precise new combination is a uniform all-length finite-field adjoint centralizer polynomial and an explicit characteristic-two affine Lie isomorphism between consecutive truncated-derivation algebras. The 2013 Yao–Chang work already gives a centralizer description for the classical p-dimensional Witt algebra at p>3, which is acknowledged as older coverage; 2014 Premet studies a different, odd-characteristic restricted setting. Neither inspected full text states or implies the characteristic-two parity isomorphism. Published nearby records have different Lie algebras; specialist modular-characteristic literature not exhaustively indexed remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: An older modular Lie-algebra monograph may record the characteristic-two affine normal form under alternate Cartan-type notation.
